notes: Uploads become playlists. A zip or a folder is now a playlist named after it, its artist folders become the pieces' artists, and it lists first: Playlists sort newest first, with a button to switch to by name. Artists get their photographs from Wikipedia, bands and singers included, and a piece without one keeps its roll card. Songs uploaded before this update are repaired on the first launch: grouped into a playlist, with their artists filled in. Loose files dropped on the web panel go into Uploads, and the panel's Add tab says which playlist an upload went to, with a button to open it.
